description: Read the checks of one conformance run on this account that failed, could not be graded or carried a warning, each with the rule it broke and the clause of the OCPI spec it was graded against, quoted. Answers: why did this run fail, and what does the spec say.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call. Omit to start at the first check.
